name: 林宜樺
objective:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Conversation 1 (Topic: World News - Europe)
Week 3: Conversation 2 (Topic: Work Environment)
Week 4: Conversation 3 (Topic: small talk with strangers)
Week 5: Role Play (Short play)
Week 6: Conversation 4 (Topic: World News - North and South America)
Week 7: Conversation 5 (Topic: Taboo)
Week 8: Conversation 6 (Topic: Debate)
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Conversation 7 (Topic: World News - Asia)
Week 11: Conversation 8 (Topic: Speech)
Week 12: Conversation 9 (Topic: Impromptu Speech)
Week 13: Role Play 2 (Short play)
Week 14: Conversation 10 (Topic: World News - Africa)
Week 15: Conversation 11 (Topic: Current trends)
Week 16: Conversation 12 (Topic: Current Trends - free of choice)
Week 17: Role Play 3 (Short play)
Week 18: Final Eaxm
